concept: A price feed account that is not pinned to a canonical account lets a caller choose which valid historical price the protocol reads.
scene: Dark navy card with a technical look: two parallel transaction lines, one reading the latest price from a real feed account and one reading an older price from a custom account, both inside the same age window band, with the amber highlight on the custom account.
alt_text: Technical diagram on a navy background showing two transactions reading different prices, one latest and one older, with the older price coming from a custom account highlighted in amber.
